result.reason: The clause provides the preferred six-month transition period at then-current rates, but data export is due within 30 days of Customer's request rather than within 30 days after expiry or termination; absent a request, no return or deletion obligation arises. It also requires deletion of all Customer Data upon termination of any single Order Form, potentially affecting data supporting continuing Order Forms. The deletion certification has no clear deadline. These issues prevent the operative language from reaching the preferred or fallback position and unnecessarily risk disrupting ongoing services.
